confidence_notes: Meal, coffee and beer estimates draw on [Numbeo’s Brno data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Brno). Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain and use [local drink guidance](https://thingstodoinbrno.com/nightlife/) and their price relationship to beer. July accommodation prices are holistic estimates and can vary with dates and events.
comparable_city_reasoning: Brno is a Central European second city with university, business and leisure demand, generally less expensive than Prague.
